HOW_TO_UPDATE: 1. Edit this file in any text editor (VS Code, Notepad++, etc.)
2. Save the file - the website updates automatically on next build/refresh.
3. JSON rules: all text must be in double quotes, no trailing commas after the last item in a list.
4. For photos: place the image in public/assets/team-portraits/ and set the path like /assets/team-portraits/filename.jpg
5. If someone has no photo yet, set photo to null (no quotes).
6. Social links: leave as empty string if not available.

FIELD_GUIDE.id: Unique ID - use PRN for students, FAC-01/FAC-02 for faculty
FIELD_GUIDE.name: Full name including Dr./Prof. prefix if applicable
FIELD_GUIDE.position: Official designation shown on the website
FIELD_GUIDE.branch: Dept code: ECS, AIDS, CE, IT, EXTC, ME (null if unknown)
FIELD_GUIDE.council: One of: Faculty Leadership, Senior Council, Junior Council, Coordinators
FIELD_GUIDE.domain: Functional area: Technical, Design, Media, Creative, Editorial, Executive, etc.
FIELD_GUIDE.photo: Path to portrait image e.g. /assets/team-portraits/exec-tejraj.jpg or null
FIELD_GUIDE.bio: 2-3 sentence description of their role and responsibilities
FIELD_GUIDE.linkedin: Full LinkedIn profile URL or empty string
FIELD_GUIDE.github: Full GitHub profile URL or empty string
FIELD_GUIDE.instagram: Full Instagram profile URL or empty string (optional)
